description: Find places and stations by name, kind, category, area, nearness or opening time. Answers only from data-standard v1 records; null values are reported as not_known. It does not return train times: for a station's exits or its last trains, call get_station_exit with the station name.

kind.description: exit: give the station name in query; returns that station's exits.

near.description: Sort by straight-line distance from a station (name or place_id).

walk_max.description: Minutes on foot from the station (only records with a walk).

name: search_verified_places
title: Search verified places
